title: Read open tab without navigation
user: I'm looking at a repo in the browser. Tell me the project name, roughly how many stars it has, and the latest commit subject—use the open tab only, don't navigate away or open new tabs.
observe: Calls closedai_app.state or embedded_browser read tools before answering
Does not navigate away from the repo URL
Answer cites plausible repo facts (stars, recent commit)
Completes without pausing the turn (no Escape / stop)

title: Open a docs URL in the embedded browser
user: Open https://example.com in the embedded browser next to this chat and confirm the main heading text once the page is ready.
observe: Uses embedded_browser or closedai_app browser_tab rather than OS open/xdg-open
Waits for load or idle before claiming the heading

title: Orient from app state
user: Before changing anything: what folder is this chat working in, which model is selected here, and is the browser pane visible?
observe: Answers cwd/project path, model id, and browser visibility correctly
Does not mutate browser tabs or send spurious UI clicks

title: Quick web lookup
user: Use the app's search tools (not the browser search box) to find what major Electron version shipped around August 2025 and give a one-sentence answer with a source link if the tool returns one.
observe: Uses search.query or search.run—not embedded_browser navigate to Google
Single focused answer; no long essay
Mentions Electron 44 or cites a reasonable source from results
